mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.member_id, o.order_date, o.order_status, o.total_price, m.address, m.name as memberName, m.id as memberLoginId, (SELECT i.item_name FROM item_order io JOIN item i ON io.item_id = i.item_id WHERE io.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 1) as firstItemName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_order io WHERE io.order_id = o.order_id) as itemCount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.order_status, o.total_price, m.address, m.name as memberName, m.id as memberLoginId, m.phone as memberPhone, m.email as memberEmail FROM orders o JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.member_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT i.item_name, io.order_price, io.count, io.selected_color, io.selected_size FROM item_order io JOIN item i ON io.item_id = i.item_id WHERE io.order_id = #{orderId}
